pages.text: Moist heat kills by the decade: every D minutes at a temperature, nine in ten of what is alive die, and D itself falls tenfold for every 10 K hotter (z = 10 K). Sterile means a millionth of a millionth left: twelve decades.
$(thing)Set$(): Hold time, Steam temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Air pockets: the kill varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The packs scorch.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Shorter holds are faster.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Decimal reduction time: D(T) = D₁₂₁·10^((394 − T)/10)$(br)Tenfold reductions: log N₀/N = t / D
